fullDescription:
Immerse in the ultimate self-documentation experience with our comprehensive heritage planner. The uniqueness of this planner lies in the core values— thorough categorization and holistic documentation. It serves as an all-inclusive record keeper, capturing your personal and medical history, data of family members, key contacts, social media accounts, and even information about your beloved pets.

Business or financial documents, letters to loved ones, and your final wishes; we’ve left no stone unturned. All your essentials will be kept up-to-date and easily accessible under one roof. The minimalist design with lucid instructions makes navigating through information as easy as pie. With our organized modular structure, your loved ones will be able to locate the required information rapidly and effortlessly.

Our open-space design offers enough legroom to capture your thoughts legibly. Feel free to use it as a space to record your deepest sentiments in an intimate letter— those hard-to-convey messages can now be shared gracefully.

This all-in-one planner ensures safety of precious information about you and your life, eliminating the need to search different sources to regain vital particulars. A smartly designed system to replace the outdated yearly planner, its comprehensive and user-friendly layout aids keeping a back-up conveniently.

This Heritage Planner includes:
• Part 1: Personal Information (Adult and Child)
• Part 2: Key Contact Information
• Part 3: My Pets Information
• Part 4: Medical Information
• Part 5: Finances
• Part 6: Financial Information
• Part 7: Social Media
• Part 8: Combo Information
• Part 9: Final Wishes

Maximize your productivity with our pre-formulated templates. Customize them on Canva to match your brand, optimize time and foster your profits efficiently. Perfect for bloggers, business and finance coaches, content creators, Etsy and Shopify store owners.

Feel the power of Canva—a high-performing design software. A free version is sufficient for editing the given templates, allowing you to modify colors, elements, sizes, fonts, and icons with great ease.

Package includes:
• Total of 72 different Canva templates.
• 8.5″*11″ size Canva link (Resizing option available with Canva)
